mbhard — do SIFT3D landmarks help affine initialisation and Sobolev SyN?

Generated 2026-09-14 17:13 by scripts/benchmark_mbhard_landmark_guidance.py. Pair: NKI-TRT-20-2 (fixed) → MMRR-21-2 (moving), DKT31 manual labels. Preprocessing: NLM denoise (antstorch, MPS), no N4, 2-98% norm. Landmarks: match_sift3d_with_rotation_search → 182 RANSAC-affine inlier pairs (75% share a whole-brain label; global rotation 0.0°), 16 s.

Part 1 — affine initialisation

A: robust_affine(mode='auto'). B: least-squares affine on the inlier landmark pairs. C: B refined by intensity (robust_affine(initial_transform=B, multi_start=False)). Similarity is measured between the fixed T1 and the affinely resampled moving T1 (image_compare; ncc_foreground = Pearson on fixed foreground). Dice = bidirectional symmetric DKT31.

Part 2 — Sobolev SyN with landmark-cluster guidance

All arms start from affine A unless stated; levels [4,2,1], iters [100,100,20], sobolev alpha 1.5, grad_step 0.25. Guidance: k-means clusters of inlier landmarks, 3 mm Gaussian blobs, softmax-like normalisation, soft Dice per cluster channel; channels = [T1 (cc2)] + K cluster maps (soft Dice), weights [1−w] + [w/K]·K.
